parameters.name: date_field
parameters.description:
Filter by date.
**Allowed values:** applied_at, hired_at, last_acted_on_at

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description:
The start date with which to filter the `date_field`.
Returns apps with a timestamp at or after midnight (12:00:00 AM) on the date specified
**format:** YYYY-MM-DD

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description:
The end date with which to filter the `date_field`.
Returns apps with a timestamp up to and including 11:59:59PM on the date specified
**format:** YYYY-MM-DD
